verifiedImplementation.attributeNormalization: a_internal[j]=attribute_weights[j]*a[j]; no extent or ErrorAbsolute adjustment to these weights.
verifiedImplementation.errorAbsolute: With ErrorAbsolute, squared combined error limit=(0.001/S)^2; returned error=sqrt(max accepted combined quadric error)*S.
verifiedImplementation.attributeError: Area-weighted squared residual between original per-triangle affine field prediction at the candidate position and the retained candidate attribute. Attribute term is not divided by accumulated area; it is added to normalized positional quadric error.

derivedUnits.formula: e_attr_m^2 ~= sum over accumulated triangle quadrics of A_t_m2 * sum_j (w_j * residual_tj)^2. Accumulated support can include quadric multiplicity.
derivedUnits.consequence: For nearly uniform residual over support scale ell=sqrt(accumulated area), e_attr_m ~= ell*norm(weighted residual). Attribute weights are inverse-attribute units, not meters. Changing to ErrorAbsolute does not justify multiplying attribute weights by0.001 or by model extent.
derivedUnits.example: One normalized residual unit on1mm support costs approximately1mm; on10mm support it costs approximately10mm. No universal weight converts this area-integrated cost into a pointwise angular/L1 guarantee.

conditionalOneCandidateProposal.namedFieldChannels: For k globally varying actual named fields, equal coefficient sqrt(k)/0.3. Cauchy-Schwarz gives L1<=sqrt(k)*L2, so L1>0.3 implies weighted L2>1.
